SET YOUR STRETCH 1/6

Pause
Normal
PRIMARY
Gastrocnemius
SECONDARY
Soleus

Instructions

1

Stand tall; lower heels below the step.

2

Push through forefeet; keep knees softly straight.

3

Lift heels high and squeeze your calves.

4

Pause briefly; keep your torso upright.

5

Lower your heels slowly without bouncing.

6

Let heels sink below the step gently.

Watch out

Bouncing out of the bottom. Pause in the stretch, drive to full tiptoe, and lower slowly — no springs.
